title: When the body starts to waver
subtitle: A shorter sitting for anxiety under the Creator’s care
description: Start with the question Guru Arjan asks the trembling heart: why waver when the One who made you still gives support?

heroSource.shortMeaning: The Creator who formed you also protects and nourishes you; anxiety is asked to answer that mercy.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When the forecast begins, pause long enough to ask whether fear is telling the truth about the One who sustains you.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle does not argue anxiety down with optimism. It places the trembling body before the Creator who protects, nourishes, and cherishes each heart.
evidence.turn: From forecasted danger into remembered care.
evidence.practicalImplication: Move through the three steps when anxiety starts building a future without mercy: receive protection, practice the anxiety turn, then let Hukam widen the field beyond the feared outcome.
